This service requirement is for a countywide provision of Safe Accommodation (refuge) and Support Services for victims/survivors of domestic abuse across West Northamptonshire and North Northamptonshire. The joint commissioning of this Service is in direct response to the local authorities' statutory responsibilities within the Domestic Abuse Act and the accompanying Domestic Abuse Statutory Guidance Framework 2021.

title: Support and Personal Care Dynamic Purchasing System Call-Off Agreement for Stirchley House Enablement Care Block
description: This contract is for block support for an enablement unit located within an Extra Care scheme within Telford and Wrekin (Stirchley House). The care will support discharges from hospital to cater for individuals with both housing and care requirements and an intermediate level, aiming to retain as much independence as possible. The care is sourced from the in-house care provider who is already integrated within the extra care setting.
